sloka: वैनतेयसमाः केचित् केचित्तत्रानिलोपमाः ।असङ्गगतयः शीघ्रा हरिवीरा महाबलाः ।। ५.५१.१४।।।।
transliteration: vainateyasamāḥ kecit kecittatrānilopamāḥ ।asaṅgagatayaḥ śīghrā harivīrā mahābalāḥ ।। 5.51.14।।।।

translations.english: "Some of the very powerful heroes equal to Garuda, equal to the Windgod (in swiftness) have gone (in quest of Sita) without touching the earth.
